title: Anthropic prices into a market that has stopped paying up for AI
summary: Anthropic sets the price of its Nasdaq offering on Wednesday evening, with trading due to begin on 19 November under the symbol ANT. It is selling 825 million Class A shares at $70 to $78, which would raise up to $64.4bn and value the company near $1.4tn on a fully diluted basis, with as much as a fifth reserved for retail buyers. Orders closed on Tuesday with demand reported at about seven times the shares on offer, even as the Nasdaq has fallen roughly 5% in a month.
